description: StockMap's read of one US sector or industry, by name (Information Technology, semiconductors, banks): its 2-week lean from the model's nightly calls, how its stocks' calls split, its industries, and its largest stocks with each one's call and move on the day. Use it when someone asks how a US sector or industry looks, or which of its stocks look strong or weak. Each answer carries the not-advice line and the run date.
